slides.title: Five bugs explain the whole debug bill
slides.takeaway: Four of five were invisible at room temperature
slides.source: Source: AS5200 bring-up defect log, BRT-042
rows: Link up at 2.5 GT/s, never faster
EQ never locks at 125 °C — RcvrLock loop
RX eye collapses under preset 8-4 when hot
Posted writes drain ahead of the CplD
Doorbell write crosses CDC; target misses it
Hot reset raced FLR; config space left in D3
slides.note: Severity ranked by field exposure; bugs 1–3 get deep dives next

slides.title: Bug 1: a loop the firmware called a link
slides.takeaway: Availability beats bandwidth — bounded retry, then downgrade
bullets: Firmware polled one bit: link-up — LTSSM was looping in Recovery
At 125 °C the endpoint loses the Gen4 RX preset; EQ never locks
Fix: three-strike bound, then force Gen3 and log to the REB
Lesson: a KPI is a state machine, not a register

slides.title: Bug 2: the 25 °C lie the lab told us
slides.takeaway: No LTSSM sign-off without a four-point chamber sweep
bullets: Room temperature: equalization passes on the first preset
125 °C chamber: RX eye collapses under preset 8-4 — 3/32 UI
Retry with full EQ at preset 5-4 locks the eye at 5/32 UI
Gen3 fallback ships the car while the RX EQ respin lands

slides.title: Bug 3: the completion was late, not lost
slides.takeaway: Posted-first ordering is mandatory; arm the timer for it
